deadline.value: Fall applications are due by February 1; the Graduate School admits on a rolling basis and late applications are considered if funding remains.

gre_general.value: The department says GRE scores are not required and submitting them is optional.
gre_general.quote: At this time GRE scores are not required for applications to graduate programs at Texas Tech. Submitting GRE scores remains optional.

gre_subject.value: The GRE Physics Subject Test is optional; provisional admission is possible before it is taken.
gre_subject.quote: At this time GRE scores are not required for applications to graduate programs at Texas Tech. Submitting GRE scores remains optional.

toefl_min.value: The physics department asks international applicants for a TOEFL score of 79 or higher, on the old iBT scale.
toefl_min.quote: Scored 79 or higher on the TOEFL if an international student

supervisor.value: The department pages do not say whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The application page does not describe how many admitted students are funded.

entry_route.value: The admission page lists GRE, transcripts and letters but does not say whether a master's is needed.

notes: Astronomy has no separate PhD in the Graduate School list (only Physics, Ph.D. under Physics and Astronomy).
name: Physics, Ph.D.
